status: Frozen together with suite.json and docs/metrology/evidence-sufficiency-method.md before any classifier was implemented or run. Exploratory local prespecification.
question: Does TRIAD's claim-relative evidence assessment identify unsupported reliability claims more reliably than standard evidence checks, without rejecting valid claims more often?
suite: benchmarks/evidence-validation/suite.json (64 cases: 13 repository-record cases with ground truth fixed by earlier milestones, 47 constructed cases, 4 misleading-input cases).

methods.standard_checks_c: Baseline C of section 5: schema validation, missing-evidence warnings, provenance hash checks, established metric reporting with supplied or i.i.d. Clopper-Pearson intervals, attestations accepted.
methods.c_plus_scope: Pre-declared sensitivity variant: C plus the scope rule A4.

information_budget: Each method receives the identical case JSON and the identical repository file tree; neither sees ground truth.

definitions.false_rejection: ground truth supported_within_scope but classified insufficient_evidence or contradicted
definitions.audit_complete: for a detected unsupported case, at least one insufficient or contradict reason names the ground-truth dimension (baseline C reports no dimensions beyond its check names and is scored on its check names mapped to dimensions)

primary_endpoint: Difference in unsupported-claim detection rate, TRIAD minus C, over all unsupported cases.
decision_rule: Audit advantage on this suite iff the detection-rate difference is at least 0.20 AND TRIAD's false-rejection rate is at most C's plus 0.05. The exact two-sided McNemar test on discordant detection pairs is reported as a suite-internal descriptive statistic; cases are not a random sample of real-world claims, so no population inference is drawn.
secondary: results by category and by source (repository-record, constructed, misleading-input)
ablations removing each TRIAD rule family
attribution of every TRIAD-C discordant case to the rule family responsible
reviewer effort: not objectively measured; only the count of findings that depend on supplied (unverified) evidence is reported as a proxy
interpretation_limits: A result on this suite demonstrates engineering detection capability on author-constructed cases, not general real-world scientific validity. Misleading-input cases are expected to defeat both methods and are counted.
prohibitions: No case, ground truth, rule or threshold may change after the first classifier run.
